doctrine: Azure Reach is a workplace comedy inside an extravagant, social-media-famous marine destination. The park itself is a source of wonder, status and temptation; the institution keeps trying to brand, package, rank, livestream and monetize that wonder. Stories turn on judgment, taste, access, interpretation, relationships and conflicting definitions of what a good public experience should be—not on process improvement, workflow optimization or operational excellence as drama. Competence is the baseline, but no department owns reality. The ensemble can disagree intelligently, change one another's minds, and sometimes decide that the right outcome should not be formalized, scaled or measured.

continuity.shellabrationSaturdays: background Corporate bad-roadmap joke only; never a flagship issue
continuity.pelicanDrop: historical development only unless explicitly revived
continuity.animals: never endangered and never the joke
continuity.dramaticEngine: Never resolve an issue because the team discovered a better process, repeatable workflow, dashboard, methodology or scalable operating model. Those tools may support a story but may not be its emotional or thematic payoff.
continuity.parkAbundance: Azure Reach should feel far larger than any one issue: an over-the-top high-end marine destination with abundant habitats, animals, gardens, dining, galleries, promenades and prestige amenities. Use background and transitional glimpses freely so readers constantly discover more of the park.
continuity.softEnvironmentContinuity: Story-critical locations and immediate panel geography stay consistent. Incidental galleries, tanks, habitat glimpses, luxury amenities and background animal displays are soft continuity: variation is welcome when it makes the park feel larger.
